calls.title: The college wording rule: keep the colleges' wording where an official number reaches a group whose title shares no word with it?
calls.text: 36 groups of credit-recommendation wordings reach an official C-ID number whose title shares no word with what the colleges wrote. One example: the POST Basic Academy wording "3 hours in Physical Training and Health Education (CSU GE Area E)" is tied to C-ID AJ 110, "Introduction to Criminal Justice." A yes keeps the colleges' wording for those groups and flags each course-number link for a check, and it puts a date back on the curation clock. These 36 are a different list from the 36 held exhibit titles; they share only the count.
calls.if_no_reply: The 36 groups stay held for a check, and the rest of the credit-recommendation work goes on.

next_step.title: Match MAP's credit recommendation wording to ACE's
next_step.text: Of the 29,995 credit recommendations in the list, 202 match ACE's wording exactly, 3,334 are in MAP only, and 26,459 differ in spelling or in substance. The exact match work is parked as issue 3523 for a later session.
